environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway HTTP API with no WAF. Lambda connects to Aurora MySQL 8.0 cluster via VPC. Database credentials stored in SSM Parameter Store. The database user specified in credentials has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP) on the products database. No query-level auditing or restrictions beyond network-level VPC security groups allowing Lambda-to-RDS traffic on port 3306.

config.db_user_grants: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON products_db.* TO 'lambda_app_user'@'%'
config.network: Lambda in private subnet, RDS in isolated subnet, SG allows 3306 from Lambda SG
